home.welcomeDesc:
Core features work out of the box: tags, documents, smart views and full-text search.
Configure AI to unlock semantic search, auto-linking and AI chat.
home.emptyAllDesc: Click the button below to create your first Markdown document. To import an existing file, use the Import tab — one .md / .txt / .zip / .docx at a time. Zip local images with the document.
home.emptyFilteredDesc: Try a different smart view, or create a new document.

inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.description: Random notes, clippings and drafts. They only appear under “All documents” after you promote them via “Add to notes”.
inbox.titlePlaceholder: Title (optional; leave empty for current time)
inbox.bodyPlaceholder: Paste content or a link note (Markdown)…
inbox.emptyDesc: Capture a snippet or link first, then promote it to a proper note once it's tidy.

archived.title: Archive
archived.description: Content worth keeping that's out of date (e.g. resolved issue notes). Archived documents don't appear under “All documents”, and AI answers don't cite them by default.
archived.restoreTitle: Restore to notes (back to all documents)
archived.emptyDesc: Archive outdated-but-keepable content from the document page.

trash.title: Trash
trash.description: Deleted documents are kept here and can be restored anytime. Note: share links are permanently revoked on deletion — re-enable sharing after restoring.
trash.emptyDesc: Deleted documents will show up here and can be restored anytime.
trash.deleteMessage: The document and all its content will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone. History, references, and share links are removed as well.
trash.emptyTrashMessage: {{count}} documents in trash will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.

newDoc.markdownPlaceholder:
# Start writing here

Supports **bold**, code blocks and [[wiki-link]] placeholders

Placeholders are resolved into block nodes on save
newDoc.dropHint: Drop or click to select a single .md / .txt / .zip / .docx file
newDoc.dropHintSub: One file at a time. If the document references local images, zip the images with the document and import the archive
newDoc.missingLocalImages: This document references {{n}} local images ({{names}}). Zip the images with the document, then import the archive.
newDoc.importMultipleFiles: Import one file at a time. If the document includes images, zip them together first.
newDoc.importUnsupportedFile: Unsupported file type. Choose .md / .txt / .zip / .docx; put images in a zip with the document.

resources.title: Resources
resources.description: Images pasted or uploaded into notes are stored here. Images only for now — local storage is primary; remote hosting is optional. Click to enlarge; unused images can be deleted.
resources.emptyDesc: Paste or drop an image in the editor and it will show up here.
resources.deleteMessage: Removes the local asset file. This cannot be undone. Images still used in notes cannot be deleted.
resources.deleteInUse: This image is still referenced by a document
resources.uploadExistingHint: Batch-upload local images without a hosted URL
resources.cleanupHint: Delete images not referenced by any document (orphans from discarded inbox items etc.)
resources.cleanupMessage: This deletes all images not referenced by any document (including on-disk files). This cannot be undone. Remote-host records are removed too.

share.notFoundTitle: This link doesn't exist or has been closed
share.notFoundDesc: The author may have turned off sharing for this document.
share.publicBanner: This is a public share page — anyone with the link can read it without logging in
